item.title: Khaleda Zia set for medical evacuation to UK
item.description: Dhaka – Ailing former Bangladeshi prime minister Khaleda Zia may be flown to the United Kingdom for advanced medical care as her condition remains largely unchanged at a Dhaka hospital. item.title: Bangladesh to announce election, referendum schedule Thursday
item.description: Dhaka – The Election Commission is expected to announce the schedule for the upcoming parliamentary election on Thursday. Alongside the 13th parliamentary election, the commission will also announce the schedule for the country’s third constitutional referendum, with both polls to be held on the same day. Chief Election Commissioner AMM Nasir Uddin will announce the schedule in a televised […]

item.title: Bangladesh sees surge in expatriate voter registration
item.description: Dhaka – For the first time, over 300,000 Bangladeshi expatriates have registered to vote through postal ballot service in the upcoming parliamentary election, the Election Commission (EC) announced on Thursday. item.title: Bangladesh’s parliamentary election, referendum on February 12
item.description: Dhaka – Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) AMM Nasir Uddin on Thursday announced that the next parliamentary election would be held on February 12 (Thursday) next year. item.description: Dhaka – The government on Monday issued a special policy to allow firearms license for politically important individuals and the candidates for the upcoming parliamentary election. item.description: Dhaka – Millions paid glowing tribute on Tuesday to the war heroes who laid down their lives for the birth of the nation 54 years ago, in a bloody war for independence. item.title: Hadi’s body returns from Singapore
item.description: Dhaka – The body of Sharif Osman Hadi, a key leader of last year’s mass uprising, arrived in Dhaka on Friday from Singapore, where he died in a hospital on Thursday night. item.title: Chief Adviser condemns attacks on media, vows support
item.description: Dhaka – Chief Adviser Muhammad Yunus on Friday condemned the attack on two of the country’s leading media houses, stating it was tantamount to an assault on free media itself. “This incident has created a major obstacle to the nation’s democratic progress and the path of independent journalism,” he said. item.description: Dhaka – A one-day state mourning is being observed across Bangladesh on Saturday to honor Sharif Osman Hadi, who died in a Singapore hospital a week after being shot by masked assailants in Dhaka.
